[EN] I only sell items to those who cooperate with us. You'll want to help us first if you want to do business with me.
[ES] Solo vendo objetos a quienes cooperan con nosotros. Primero tendrás que ayudarnos si quieres hacer negocios conmigo.

[EN] Help us and you will get many items in return.
[ES] Ayúdanos y recibirás muchos objetos a cambio.

[EN] Thank you for always helping us. Let me know if there are any items you need.
[ES] Gracias por ayudarnos siempre. Avísame si necesitas algún objeto.
